# Tessix Networks

Tessix Networks specializes in ProcureLearn, a procurement platform designed specifically for educational technology purchasing by K-12 school districts. The product streamlines vendor selection, funding allocation, and compliance tracking to simplify and optimize edtech procurement processes.

ProcureLearn serves district administrators, procurement officers, and IT coordinators seeking transparency and efficiency in purchasing adaptive tutoring and mastery tracking tools. Over the past fiscal year, Tessix Networks facilitated $30 million in district contracts across 45 school districts, demonstrating strong market traction.

Founded three years ago, Tessix Networks recently closed a $12 million Series A round led by EdVentures Capital. The team combines expertise in education technology, supply chain logistics, and software development.

Key competitors include EduSource Direct, ScholarBid, and DistrictBuy. Open risks include evolving district budget cycles and integration challenges with legacy ERP systems, which the team actively addresses through ongoing platform enhancements.
